visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: POWER INPUT - 5.5 mm x 2.1 mm center-positive barrel jack. External certified 5 VDC supply only. No 120 VAC on PCB.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: J1 pinout/land-pattern, PTC derating, AO3401A-class PMOS pinmap/orientation, TVS MPN, and bulk capacitor MPN remain NEEDS_REVIEW before layout.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: 3.3 V REGULATOR - AP63203WU-7 fixed 3.3 V buck, 2 A class. Planning values used: L=3.9uH, Cin=10uF, Cout=2x22uF, CBST=100nF.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: Exact inductor saturation current/DCR, MLCC voltage derating, thermal copper, and JLC/LCSC availability remain NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: ESP32-S3 MODULE - Preferred module ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8. Symbol is KiCad ESP32-S3-WROOM-1; -1U module/land-pattern equivalence remains NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: Antenna: use WROOM-1U module U.FL/IPEX connector with U.FL/IPEX-to-SMA pigtail and enclosure 2.4 GHz antenna. Keepout/pigtail routing NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: RESET/BOOT - Espressif-style EN: 10k pullup to 3V3, 1uF to GND, reset switch to GND. BOOT/GPIO0: 10k pullup, switch to GND.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: USB-C PROGRAMMING/DEBUG - native ESP32-S3 USB. CC1/CC2 each 5.1k to GND. VBUS and shield policy are BLOCKED_NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: Rough draft leaves USB VBUS not tied to +5V_PROTECTED. Add a verified power/sense/backfeed policy before schematic freeze.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: LEDS - component report recommends simple GPIO LED over WS2812 for low cost/reliability. Status LED GPIO assignment remains NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: TEST/DEBUG PADS - Keep USB test pads optional only if routing does not create long stubs. UART0 TX/RX included for fallback debug.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: MECHANICAL - Compact rectangular board, four M2.5 planning holes, barrel jack and USB-C at enclosure wall, antenna pigtail/SMA clearance reserved.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: Mount hole drill, board outline, connector overhang, standoff keepouts, and SMA/pigtail route are enclosure-driven and remain NEEDS_REVIEW.

visible_schematic_items.name: text
visible_schematic_items.text: NEEDS_REVIEW before schematic freeze: exact MPNs/land-patterns, AO3401A pinmap/package orientation, USB VBUS/backfeed policy, USB shield EMC network, final LED GPIO, antenna/enclosure mechanics, and deeper component/value review.
